'''Kadenokōji Akitomi''' (勘解由小路 在富) was a noble and {{ill|Onmyōji|en|Onmyōji|qid=Q2274163|lt=Onmyōji}} of the {{ill|Sengoku Period (Japan)|ja|戦国時代|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sengoku period (Japan)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q117415390}}. He held the Ranks of {{ill|Shōni|ja|正二位|ko|정2위|zh|正二位|qid=Q11123277}} and {{ill|Hisanagi|ja|非参議}}, and served as the head of the {{ill|Onmyōryō|ja|陰陽寮}}. Born as the son of {{ill|Kadenokōji Arishige|ja|勘解由小路在重}}, he was the last effective head of the {{ill|Kadenokōji family|ja|勘解由小路家}}.

== Biography ==
Born to Kadenokōji Arishige and a daughter of {{ill|Machi Akiyuki|ja|町顕郷}}, Akitomi was initially named Akihide (在秀). 

In {{ill|Eishō (Muromachi period)|cs|Eišó|fa|ایشو (دوره موروماچی)|fr|Ère Eishō (Muromachi)|ja|永正|ko|에이쇼 (센고쿠 시대)|no|Eishō (Sengoku)|ru|Эйсё|simple|Eishō (Muromachi period)|sr|Еишо (Муромачи период)|sv|Eishō (Sengoku)|tr|Eishō (Muromachi)|zh|永正|qid=Q1193577|lt=Eishō}} 4 ({{ill|1507|en|1507|qid=Q6161|lt=1507}}), he received the Rank of {{ill|Jugoi|ja|従五位下|lt=Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade}} and was appointed {{ill|Ministry of War (pre-modern Japan)|ja|兵部少輔|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hyōbu Shōsuke|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 兵部省|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 兵部省|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q3276048}}. By {{ill|Eishō (Muromachi period)|cs|Eišó|fa|ایشو (دوره موروماچی)|fr|Ère Eishō (Muromachi)|ja|永正|ko|에이쇼 (센고쿠 시대)|no|Eishō (Sengoku)|ru|Эйсё|simple|Eishō (Muromachi period)|sr|Еишо (Муромачи период)|sv|Eishō (Sengoku)|tr|Eishō (Muromachi)|zh|永正|qid=Q1193577|lt=Eishō}} 9 ({{ill|1512|en|1512|qid=Q6192|lt=1512}}), he became {{ill|Reki Hakase|ja|暦博士|lt=Doctor of Calendar}}, and in {{ill|Eishō (Muromachi period)|cs|Eišó|fa|ایشو (دوره موروماچی)|fr|Ère Eishō (Muromachi)|ja|永正|ko|에이쇼 (센고쿠 시대)|no|Eishō (Sengoku)|ru|Эйсё|simple|Eishō (Muromachi period)|sr|Еишо (Муромачи период)|sv|Eishō (Sengoku)|tr|Eishō (Muromachi)|zh|永正|qid=Q1193577|lt=Eishō}} 11 ({{ill|1514|en|1514|qid=Q6204|lt=1514}}), he was also appointed {{ill|Yin-Yang Bureau|ja|陰陽頭|lt=Onmyō no kami}}. He held multiple concurrent roles, including {{ill|Meryō|ja|左馬頭|lt=Head of the Meryō}} and {{ill|Ministry of the Imperial Household|ja|宮内卿|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kunaikyō|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮内省|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮内省|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q8193428}}.

In {{ill|Kyōroku|en|Kyōroku|qid=Q1193418|lt=Kyōroku}} 4 ({{ill|1531|en|1531|qid=Q6431|lt=1531}}), Akitomi reached the Rank of {{ill|Shōsanmi|ja|従三位}}. For his close service to {{ill|Emperor Go-Nara|en|Emperor Go-Nara|qid=Q349467|lt=Emperor Go-Nara}}, he was promoted to {{ill|Shōni|ja|従二位}} in {{ill|Tenbun 5|ja|天文5年}} ({{ill|1536|en|1536|qid=Q6457|lt=1536}}), and later to {{ill|Seoni|ja|正二位|ko|정2위|zh|正二位|qid=Q11123277}} in {{ill|1551|ja|天文20年|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenbun 20|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 1551年|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 1551年|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q6560}} ({{ill|1551|en|1551|qid=Q6560|lt=1551}})—a first for his family.

However, his sole son, {{ill|Kamo Akimasa|ja|賀茂在昌}}, fled Kyoto in {{ill|Eiroku|en|Eiroku|qid=Q1143341|lt=Eiroku}} 2 ({{ill|1559|en|1559|qid=Q6609|lt=1559}}) to study Western astronomy in {{ill|Funai|ja|府内 (豊後国)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Funai|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11486078}} and became a {{ill|Kirishitan|en|Kirishitan|qid=Q718714|lt=Kirishitan}}. Left without a direct heir, Akitomi adopted {{ill|Kadenokōji Akitane|ja|勘解由小路在種}}, but their relationship ended in tragedy when Akitane was killed in {{ill|1551|ja|天文20年|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenbun 20|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 1551年|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 1551年|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q6560}}. 

Akitomi passed away on {{ill|Eiroku 8|ja|永禄8年}} ({{ill|1565|en|1565|qid=Q6634|lt=1565}}). The Kadenokōji clan faced further decline, leading to its eventual extinction.
